user_request: Test whether classifier-free guidance changes Cosmos3 and DreamZero performance.

known_result_disclosure.statement: Both baseline six-cell results were known when this exploratory ablation was selected. V2-A015 is a disclosed post-result intervention, not preregistration and not a rewrite of any frozen result.

scientific_questions: Does removing Cosmos3 Nano's existing joint action-video CFG reduce requested-task success or balanced directional margin?
Does adding moderate CFG-style action guidance to DreamZero improve execution while its official video guidance remains fixed?

arms.intervention: Change only joint latent guidance from 3.0 to 1.0; g=1 is the conditional prediction without a CFG blend.
arms.future_contract: decoded 33-frame RGB future for every policy request

arms.intervention: Use a_uncond + 2*(a_cond-a_uncond) for action-flow denoising while retaining the released video guidance at 5.0.
arms.negative_branch_caveat: The released second branch uses DreamZero's fixed visual-quality negative prompt, not a strict empty-text unconditional prompt. Results are labeled CFG-style negative-branch action guidance rather than an official DreamZero action-CFG feature.
arms.future_contract: joint latent video future retained and officially decoded at reset

requirements: Scale 1.0 must take the untouched conditional-action branch for exact baseline equivalence.
Only the action-flow prediction entering the existing scheduler may change.
Video CFG, prompt transforms, weights, noise seed, scheduler, cache mask, horizon, normalization, and controller remain unchanged.
The isolated overlay checkout and resulting file hash must be recorded before model load.

cosmos3_nano_no_cfg_g1: LEFT and exact-repeat LEFT actions and futures are bit-identical.
LEFT and RIGHT actions and decoded futures differ under identical observation and sampling seed.
Every action is finite with shape [32,8] and every future contains 33 RGB frames.
dreamzero_action_cfg_s2: The scale-1 overlay returns bit-identical actions and latent video to the unmodified official path on the frozen fixture.
Scale-2 LEFT and exact-repeat LEFT actions and latent futures are bit-identical.
Scale-2 LEFT and RIGHT actions differ under identical observation and official noise seed 1140.
Scale-2 actions are finite, shape [24,8], and pass the unchanged normalization and range contract.
Record whether the scale-2 latent video differs from scale 1 under the same request; do not require equality because guided action latents can feed back through later joint-attention denoising steps.

prompts.left: Put the Rubik's cube to the left of the bowl.
prompts.right: Put the Rubik's cube to the right of the bowl.

behavioral_grid.completion_rule: After an arm passes its release gate, run and retain all six valid cells; do not stop early for poor outcomes.

primary: requested-task success by relation and exact paired change from the preserved checkpoint baseline
requested signed final margin, oriented so positive means farther into the requested region
directional_quality: minimum LEFT/RIGHT requested margin per seed
success asymmetry and any regression from a baseline success
trajectory_quality: verified pickup, requested-region entry, release, and failure stage
completion actions for successes with failures censored at the action cap
object path length, excess path ratio, maximum excursion, action total variation, and first-chunk prompt RMS
analysis.future_rule: Report imagined/executed semantic agreement and coverage separately from robot success; requests or frames within one episode are not independent samples; missing futures are never zeros.
analysis.inference_boundary: This n=6-per-arm pilot is descriptive and exploratory. Report exact paired discordances and effect sizes; do not claim a powered improvement from a nonsignificant result.

denominator_policy: Each model and guidance configuration has its own six-cell DROID denominator.
The preserved baselines are referenced by committed hash and are not rerun or overwritten.
Fixed probes, partial runs, and infrastructure-invalid attempts remain outside behavioral denominators.
Cosmos3 Nano and DreamZero results are never pooled, and no DROID result is pooled with RoboTwin.

optional_followup_not_yet_authorized.condition: Only after both six-cell V2-A015 arms are compiled without outcome-based selection.
candidate_arms: DreamZero action guidance 3.0 with video guidance 5.0, six cells

unchanged_rules: Static episode prompts only; no oracle, coach, prompt switching, or progress-conditioned language.
Preserve every valid failure and keep technical invalidity outside model denominators.
Record complete simulator video, executed actions, and every exposed future.
Keep raw outputs, checkpoints, environments, and unbounded video on the ali-owned PVC.
